## Arachne (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
NE Large aberration  
**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +13  


**Defense**


**AC** 18, touch 11, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +7 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 84 (7d8+28)  
**Fort** +5, **Ref** +4, **Will** +8  
**Immune** mind-affecting effects  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.; climb 30 ft.  
**Melee** bite +9 (1d8+5 plus poison), slam +9 (1d6+5)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
**Special Attacks** web (+7 ranged, DC 20, 7 hp)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 21, **Dex** 15, **Con** 16, **Int** 12, **Wis** 17, **Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +11; **CMD** 23 (35 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Skill Focus (Bluff), Skill Focus (Disguise), Toughness, Weapon Focus (web)  
**Skills** Bluff +16, Climb +23, Disguise +16, Perception +17, Stealth +15; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Bluff, +8 Climb, +4 Disguise, +4 Perception, +4 Stealth (+8 webs)  
**SQ** arachne’s kiss, strong webs  
**Languages** tongues  


**Special Traits**


**Arachne’s Kiss (Ex)** Arachne’s reproduce by implanting their eggs inside living creatures. To do so an arachne must first find a helpless creature, then the female head regurgitates an egg into the other creature’s mouth. A successful Fortitude save (DC 16) makes the creature safely digest the egg. On a failed save the creature suffers 1d6 points of Strength drain every day, however, the creature may attempt another save (at the same DC) every day to prevent the egg from growing and negating the Strength drain that day. After the first failed save the creature must succeed on his saving throw two days in a row to successfully fight off the egg growing inside him. Once the creature’s Strength reaches 0, the egg hatches and the infant arachne burrows its way out of the creature, killing it instantly.  

**Poison (Ex)** Bite—injury; *save* Fort DC 16; *frequency* 1/round for 6 rounds; *effect* 1d4 Str and Dex, confused and staggered; *cure* 2 saves.  

**Strong Webs (Ex)** An arachne’s webs gain a +4 bonus to the DC to break or escape.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any underground  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** double
